name: Wetland General Permit Surcharge Restoration Program
summary: Annual call for wetland and aquatic-resource restoration projects on sites open to the public in Wisconsin, funded by surcharges on wetland general permits. Past projects typically ranged from $20,000 to $40,000.

calls.label: 2026 funding round
calls.recurring: Applications are due 15 December each year.

status.quote: The DNR is currently seeking project proposals totaling less than $100,000.

deadline.quote: All applications should be emailed to Josh Brown at JoshuaA.Brown@wisconsin.gov by December 15, 2026.

recurring.quote: Applications must be submitted by December 15 of each calendar year to be considered for that year's funding.

geography.quote: Under s. 281.36 (11), Wis. Stats., the DNR must charge a surcharge fee, to be used for wetland restoration, for each Wetland General Permit 1 issued.

access.quote: Funds generated from these surcharge fees are collected by the Department and then awarded to applicants through an annual application process.

amount.quote: Projects in past years have typically ranged from $20,000 - $40,000.
